- Group 29 (69 lines): `_prompt_default_output_location` is duplicated between
  credentials/bigquery.py:204 and credentials/redshift.py:247. Identical
  interactive prompt flow with only cloud-specific strings differing (gs:// vs
  s3://, storage_bucket vs s3_bucket, permission names).
